titleEn: Assistant writes Meta-ready templates and fixes rejections

undo.note: the template is submitted to Meta for review when the merchant confirms

en: Why was it rejected and how do I fix it?

steps: Tell the assistant what the message is for; it writes the template in Egyptian Arabic (or English on request), checks it against Meta's rules and shows it as the customer will see it, with its cost in AI credits
Press "Yes, do it" to submit it to Meta, or ask for changes or a fresh take (each fresh draft costs credits; a failed one costs nothing)
If Meta rejects a template, ask the assistant to fix it: it starts from Meta's reason and shows the corrected version before anything is sent
edgeCases: Not enough AI credits: nothing is written and nothing is charged
The draft cannot be made to pass Meta's rules after two tries: the credits are released and nothing is shown to submit
Only the owner can submit; a staff member can ask for a draft but the submit is refused by the product
A template with the same name already exists: the draft gets a new name (_v2, _v3)
assistantNote: confirm: the assistant writes, the merchant presses; submission to Meta is irreversible
